blocks.text: MOSCOW — Russia’s ambassador to the United States, Alexander Darchiev, has died suddenly at age 66 after one and a half years in the job, Moscow’s foreign ministry announced Wednesday. The ministry called Darchiev an “outstanding diplomat, an experienced leader and a kind colleague”. He was appointed in March 2025. Moscow did not give more details
